summary: BP p.l.c. filed a Form 6-K on 3 August 2026 disclosing its total voting rights and share capital as at 31 July 2026. The filing reports issued ordinary shares of 15,704,171,728 (excluding 782,141,266 treasury shares), each with one vote, and 12,706,252 preference shares with two votes per £5 nominal capital. Total voting rights are 15,709,254,228. This routine transparency notification, made under FCA Disclosure Guidance and Transparency Rules 5.6, is informational only and not a special situation; it serves to help shareholders determine notification obligations.
